text:
karan: FYI deploybot scheduled a v2 rollout to us-east-1 at 21:00 UTC. main change: header-name normalization for mobile traffic. canary + prober at 20:30?

deploybot: rollout scheduled id=rb-2026-03-21-02 -> v2 -> us-east-1. canary=5% for 30m. pause: `/deploybot pause rollout rb-2026-03-21-02`

maria: starting prober now against the canary proxy. seeing auth 401s from a subset of mobile probes (~7/120). not widespread.

taylor: paste from failing probe logs: ```
ERR auth: header "X-Client-Version" arrived as "x-client-version" -> downstream rejects -> 401
agent=mobile-sdk-android region=iad req_id=ef12ab34
```

ashley: that lines up. server change enforces canonical case to avoid duplicate headers. mobile SDKs that preserve original case will be impacted. my bad for not flagging earlier.

james: what's our pause/rollback policy here? we typically pause at >0.5% error uplift over 10m. given these are auths, maybe stricter.

karan: set a conservative hold: pause if mobile error uplift >=0.25% sustained for 5m in any region. allow targeted partial rollback for mobile route.

maria: opsbot quick summary (10m): failed_probes=7/120 regions=[iad] error_types=[401:7]

opsbot: metrics snapshot -> 10m window: rps=7.8k, p95=40ms, err_rate_global=0.07%, mobile_err_rate=0.30%

ashley: i can ship a tiny edge shim to accept either-case header and forward canonicalized name. build+canary ~25-30m. would avoid full rollback.

james: prefer a shim + hold if it's low risk. avoids global rollback and churn.

karan: agree. implement shim and pause rollout while we validate. docs-team prepare a short release-note blurb and an SDK migration note.

docs-team: will draft RN and migration doc, ETA 30m.

maria: merged shim to edge branch, kicking a 5% edge-canary now. should see traffic in ~6m. probing script: `curl -H "X-Client-Version: 1.2.3" https://edge-canary-us-east.api.redwood.internal/ping` to emulate mobile calls.

(taylor reacts :thumbsup:)

karan: deploybot, pause rollout until further notice: `/deploybot pause rollout rb-2026-03-21-02 --reason "prober auth failures - hold for shim"`

deploybot: Rollout rb-2026-03-21-02 paused by karan. status=PAUSED. operators notified.

maria: edge-canary reporting: initial health p95=44ms errors=0.01%. running mobile prober (200 reqs) now.

opsbot: edge-canary 5m summary -> p95=46ms errors=0.02%

maria: prober results after shim: 1/120 failures (transient). mobile_err_rate=0.01% over 10m. looks good.

karan: excellent. hold global rollout for a 2-hour manual observation window. no auto-resume.

james: set rollback thresholds: mobile_err_rate >0.5% sustained for 5m after resume -> rollback. immediate rollback if 503 spike >1% in any region for 3m.

ashley: i will follow up with a tiny SDK note and a PR to casefold incoming headers in older SDKs. link posted here when ready.

deploybot: Rollout held. operator note attached. to resume: `/deploybot resume rollout rb-2026-03-21-02`

karan: checklist: 1) RN pushed (docs-team) 2) edge shim canary healthy (maria) 3) rollout paused manual resume after 2h 4) rollback thresholds set (james) 5) open follow-up PR for SDKs (ashley) 6) post-mortem if spike after resume

(maria reacts :white_check_mark:)

docs-team: release-note blurb posted to release-notes channel: "v2 now normalizes header names. Mobile SDKs that assume case-insensitive headers should continue working; see migration guide for older clients."

taylor: please add a short FAQ for customers on how to handle 401s (check header casing, upgrade SDK, or apply edge shim).

karan: added. we'll re-evaluate at 22:30 UTC or sooner if needed. thanks all. :pray:
